about: P68-S T1 dev set: 20 new English sentences about one shift in a shop (buildshift), each with the expected customer (singular), goods (singular) and goal (number from the sentence clamped to the goal bounds 9..20, default 12). Written 2026-11-01 before any buildshift code; the lower bound rose from 6 to 9 on 2026-11-02 (P68-K T2: a small goal could not be lost), so s12, s17 and s20 expect 9. Tuning on these is allowed; the sealed P68-I holdout is never read.

sentences.text: robots line up for pizza at my tiny diner
run a cat cafe and serve 12 cats their milk
a penguin opens a stand on the beach and sells ice cream to 15 sweaty tourists
build a bakery where hungry dragons come for fresh bread
my little taco truck has to feed 20 hungry astronauts tacos before launch
zombies want burgers at the midnight burger joint, serve 9 of them
set up a lemonade stand and sell lemonade to 10 thirsty kids
a raccoon runs a donut shop and sleepy police dogs come for donuts
open a sushi bar and serve sushi to 14 picky cats
aliens order noodles at my space station noodle shop
a busy coffee shop where 16 office workers want their morning coffee
run a candy store and serve 8 greedy goblins their candy
monsters queue for cupcakes at the haunted cupcake bakery
my hot dog stand has to serve hot dogs to 30 football fans at halftime
a fox runs a juice bar and sells fresh juice to 11 forest animals
pirates come for fish at the harbour fish shop
serve tea to 7 sleepy grandmas in a cozy tea room
ghosts drop by my spooky pie shop for a slice of pie
run the school canteen and give lunch to 18 noisy students
dinosaurs crowd my ice cream parlour wanting milkshakes, serve 3 of them
